rationale: Paper 2309.05181 directly addresses the influence of particle wind generated by magnetic energy release in magnetars on their spindown rates and X-ray luminosities, contributing substantive new evidence to the question. However, it does not fully settle the question, particularly regarding the role of particle acceleration from fast magnetic reconnection in AGNs and compact sources.
